summary: Alvotech filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated October 14, 2026, announcing submission of a European regulatory application for AVT29, a proposed biosimilar to Eylea 8 mg (aflibercept 114.3 mg/mL), developed with Advanz Pharma. The filing describes a line extension to the existing EU marketing authorization for Mynzepli (AVT06, 2 mg aflibercept), claiming the first known worldwide regulatory submission for a high-dose aflibercept biosimilar. No financial terms, securities, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction mechanics are stated; this is a routine product/regulatory disclosure, not a special situation.
